english.note: Use the all-purpose colloquial verb 搞 for aimless messing or fidgeting, and for making small adjustments or tinkering.
This is the all-purpose choice for fiddling with something to try to fix or improve it.
Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice for interfering or messing with someone or something.

examples.english: Don't fiddle around; concentrate on your revision.
I often tinker with my phone's settings to see if I can save battery.
examples.traditional: 我成日搞部手機啲設定，睇下可唔可以慳啲電。
